goal: Expose the existing NAS prompt-engineering work as one high-quality three-candidate prompt compiler for copy, image, and video tasks before colleagues submit generation jobs.

included: one standalone /api/prompt-candidates route for copy, image, and video
three materially distinct production-ready candidates for every supported creative task
preservation of the colleague's original request, material boundaries, and selected output settings
automatic retrieval of relevant company copy, campaign, execution, and reviewed memory evidence from the Obsidian-backed NAS index
visible source title, Obsidian path, and review status for every company-memory reference
same-origin Feishu H5 access to the exact standalone compiler backend in-process by default or through an explicitly configured NAS-local service
click-to-adopt candidate prompts before final task submission
excluded: browser-side static suffix templates presented as professional prompt optimization
silent downgrade to low-detail local strings when the professional service is unavailable
exposing standalone service credentials to the browser

acceptance_criteria.description: The standalone NAS toolbox accepts copy, image, and video through one /api/prompt-candidates route and returns exactly three materially distinct prompts that preserve the original request and applicable settings.

The Feishu creative workspace requests professional candidates from its own server route, renders title, summary, and full prompt, and lets the colleague adopt a candidate before task submission without browser-side static suffix generation.

The Feishu server sends only whitelisted creative settings to the exact standalone compiler backend, keeps any configured internal service token server-side, and returns a clear unavailable error instead of silently substituting lower-quality prompts.

Before compiling copy, image, or video candidates, the NAS workspace searches data/nas_memory.db for relevant Obsidian-backed company originals and returns bounded evidence with title, source path, excerpt, document type, and review status without invoking a model.

Every candidate explicitly receives matched company memory; confirmed evidence may support facts and terminology, while need-review evidence is limited to style and inspiration and cannot be presented as verified company fact. The H5 page truthfully shows matched sources, no-match state, or index-unavailable state.
